title: Seed-Mediated Synthesis of Thin Gold Nanoplates with Tunable Edge Lengths and Optical Properties
core_system_studied: Seed-mediated synthesis of thin Au nanoplates using Au–Ag alloy nanoframes and sulfite (SO32−) ligands

parameters.name: Seed type
parameters.raw_value: Au–Ag alloy nanoframes obtained by galvanic replacement of Ag nanoplates with HAuCl4

outcome.width_nm: 7.5 nm (thickness at lowest edge length, increases with edge length)

cmo_edges.parameter_range_tested: Sulfite ligand in Au-Ag alloy nanoframes seed-mediated synthesis
cmo_edges.proposed_mechanism: Sulfite ligands complex effectively with Au(III) precursor ions to regulate reduction kinetics and govern the anisotropic growth of thin nanoplates.
cmo_edges.quantitative_effect: Edge lengths tunable from 48 nm to 167 nm.
cmo_edges.evidence_quote: run_thin_nanoplates_range: morphology=thin gold nanoplates, L=48–167 nm, W=7.5 nm

untested_assumptions_or_limitations: Nanoplate thickness increases as edge length is tuned to larger sizes
